import re
from pathlib import Path
path = Path("/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill/docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-obs-predicates-v1.1.md")
text = path.read_text()
blocks = re.split(r"^### B-\d+ · `(OBS-[^`]+)`[^\n]*\n", text, flags=re.M)
total = 0
claims = 0
for i in range(1, len(blocks), 2):
    ids = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"^  (\d+)\. ", blocks[i+1].split("\n---", 1)[0], re.M)]
    assert ids == list(range(1, len(ids)+1))
    total += len(ids)
    claims += 1
    print(f"{blocks[i]}: document={len(ids)}+4 common; encoded=0")
print(f"CLAIMS={claims}; SECTION_3={total}; COMMON={claims*4}; TOTAL_NUMBERED={total+claims*4}; ENCODED=0")
